{{Quote|The shield is down! Commence attack on the Death Star's main reactor.''"<br />"''We're on our way. Red Group, Gold Group, all fighters follow me.|Admiral Ackbar and General Lando Calrissian, ordering the assault on the Death Star's main reactor|<ref name="RotJ" />}}
'''Keir Santage''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. After being rescued from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Detention area|detention center]], Santage joined [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], the Alliance's premier [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit. Under the command of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], Santage operated under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]]. Flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], Santage participated in [[Sorties against Fondor Shipyards|several missions]] against the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], and often worked closely with Alliance [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|procurement]].

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Santage was serving with the Rogues when they were part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] assembled in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|strike]] at the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] orbiting the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. Adopting the call sign [[Red Seven/Legends|Red Seven]]&mdash;as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Antilles had temporarily rechristened the Rogues as [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to honor the unit that had [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|faced]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] at [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]&mdash;Santage was one of the handful of Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to enter the superstructure of the [[Death/Legends|Death]] Star with the intention of destroying the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. At the rear of the Rebel fighter formation, Santage's [[Red Squadron 7|X-wing]] was hit by [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire from a pursuing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]]; the snubfighter was destroyed, and Santage was killed.

==Biography==
===Early service===
Keir Santage was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] rescued from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Detention area|detention center]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who subsequently joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. Qualifying as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], he<ref name="DSII-Santage" /> flew a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="DSII-Red7" /> Assigned to the elite Rogue Squadron<ref name="DSII-Santage" /> as [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|106|Rouge Seven}}</ref> Santage participated in [[Sorties against Fondor Shipyards|twelve sorties]] against the Imperial [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="DSII-Red7" /> He also worked closely with Alliance [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|procurement]].<ref name="DSII-Santage" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Santage and Rogue Squadron were part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] assembled in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] in preparation for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] on the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Information had been obtained by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] that indicated [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would be overseeing the final construction stages of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], and Alliance command had decided that a successful strike could eliminate both Palpatine and the Death Star.<ref name="RotJ" />

===The Battle of Endor===
====Briefing and arrival at Endor====
[[File:Red_7.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Santage's T-65 X-wing starfighter]]
Santage, now a veteran pilot within the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], attended a briefing hosted by Commander Antilles on the battle plan to destroy the Death Star. The squadron was temporarily rechristened as [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to honor the original Red Squadron that had faced the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref> Santage would operate under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Red Seven/Legends|Red Seven]] during the coming battle.<ref name="DSII-Red7" /> The Alliance battle plan called for a strike force to fly into the half-completed superstructure of the Death Star and destroy the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|main reactor core]]. The resulting chain reaction explosion would then destroy the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="RotJ" /> Red Squadron&mdash;along with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]&mdash;was assigned the mission of taking out the reactor.<ref name="GG5" />

Upon arrival in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], the Alliance fleet expected the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]&mdash;generated from an Imperial [[Endor shield generator bunker|facility]] on the surface of the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] and intended to protect the Death Star during its construction&mdash;to have been disabled by a [[Endor strike team/Legends|commando unit]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. However, the shield was still protecting the battlestation, forcing the Alliance fleet to engage an Imperial force led by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. During the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engagement]]&mdash;which had been a carefully planned trap orchestrated by Palpatine himself to destroy the Alliance<ref name="RotJ" />&mdash;Red Squadron performed better than their counterparts in the newer [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] starfighters. They racked up an impressive kill count, and Red Squadron remained relatively intact throughout the battle, suffering only a small number of casualties compared to the losses of other units.<ref name="GG5" />

====Assault on the second Death Star====
{{Quote|Now lock onto the strongest power source. It should be the power generator.|General Lando Calrissian, issuing orders to Santage and the other pilots in the Death Star II reactor shaft|<ref name="RotJ" />}}
[[File:Keir_Santage.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Santage's death]]
Eventually, Solo's team was able to destroy the shield generator, exposing the Death Star to the planned Alliance attack. General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], leading the fighter wings under the call sign [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] and flying the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], ordered fighters from Red and Gold Squadrons to begin their attack on the main reactor. Santage joined Calrissian in the attack, along with [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] Commander Antilles,<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]],<ref name="DSII-Salm">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Salm}}</ref> [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]],<ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]],<ref name="DSII-Celchu">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Tycho Celchu}}</ref> and [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]], also from Green Squadron.<ref name="DSII-GSpilot">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron Pilot}}</ref>

Skimming the surface of the battlestation, Santage dodged [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire before entering the superstructure via an access shaft, taking up the rear position in the Alliance fighter formation. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] followed the Rebel fighters into the shaft, intent on destroying them before they could take out the main reactor. Navigating through the tight confines of the reactor shaft, Calrissian ordered the pilots to lock onto the strongest power source to lead them to the reactor core. Although Santage successfully avoided several obstacles in the shaft, he was exposed to the enemy; his fighter was hit by several bursts of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire from the lead TIE fighter. His fighter broke apart, and he was killed. His death prompted Calrissian to order several other fighters to break off from the assault and head back to the surface in an attempt to draw pursuit off of the strike force. Celchu, Salm, and Farrell complied, leading half of the pursuing Imperial fighters away from Calrissian and Antilles, which in turn allowed them to destroy the Death Star.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Keir Santage had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and light skin, and had grown a moustache. He was considered to be an excellent pilot, which led to his assignment to Rogue Squadron, the Alliance's elite starfighter squadron,<ref name="DSII-Santage" /> alongside notable pilots like Wedge Antilles.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> During the Battle of Endor, Santage diligently obeyed orders and followed the Alliance battle plan by flying into the interior of the Death Star in an attempt to knock out the main reactor, a decision that cost him his life.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keir Santage first appeared briefly in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="RotJ" /> where he was portrayed by [[Billy J. Mitchell]].<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=21876|text=Billy J. Mitchell|work=[https://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20210120032525}}</ref>{{Fact}} Santage was one of the pilots during the Battle of Endor sequence&mdash;specifically, during the starfighter chase down an access shaft of the Death Star II. He was unnamed, and his brief scene culminated in his death as he was shot down by a TIE starfighter.<ref name="RotJ" />

In [[2000]], [[Decipher]] released their ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. The set established Keir Santage's name, the fact that he was a Rogue Squadron veteran,<ref name="DSII-Santage" /> and that he flew as Red Seven during the battle. The image used to represent Santage's [[Red Squadron 7|X-wing]] on its CCG card<ref name="DSII-Red7" /> is actually a shot taken of Wedge Antilles' fighter from ''Return of the Jedi'' as it skims the Death Star's surface en route to the reactor shaft.<ref name="RotJ" /> It was not until the release of ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]] that Santage was confirmed to have also used the call sign of Rogue Seven during his service with the Rogues.<ref name="CSWE" />
